# Supply Agreement

This agreement is made between Northwind Traders ("Supplier") and Contoso
Pty Ltd ("Customer") on the date of the last signature below.

## 1. Definitions

"Goods" means the products listed in Schedule A. "Delivery Date" means the
date stated in a purchase order, or **ten business days** after the order if
no date is stated.

## 2. Supply

The Supplier shall deliver the Goods to the Customer's nominated address.
Title passes on *payment in full*; risk passes on delivery. Prices are
~~fixed for twelve months~~ reviewed quarterly, as set out in
[Schedule B](https://example.org/schedule-b).

### 2.1 Quality

Goods must meet the specification in Schedule A. Units are measured in m^2^
and tolerances are stated as H~2~O equivalents where relevant. Order codes
use the form `NW-0000`.

> Either party may terminate this agreement on thirty days' written notice.

---

Signed for and on behalf of the parties.
